testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and expand a template group ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser ✔ And the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the metric part template group is expanded ✔ And a sheet-metal part template is selected ✔ When the user collapses the part template group ✔ Then its template tiles are hidden ✔ And the assembly and drawing groups remain visible ✔ And the selected template's details remain displayed ✔ When the user expands the part template group ✔ Then its template tiles are visible again ✔ And the sheet-metal template remains selected
